AI/Fullstack Developer

Computer Science student specializing in AI and Data Science, passionate about turning ideas into practical solutions. Experienced in software development, machine learning and AI-driven applications, with proficiency in Python, Node.js and web development. A curious, adaptable and detail-oriented problem solver who enjoys learning and building.
